method.hypergeometric: One-sided overlap test: among the year's district offices, fix the number with exact ₱5M road entries and flood entries, then ask how often independent assignment gives at least the observed overlap.
method.region_controlled: Monte Carlo randomization shuffles which offices have exact ₱5M flood entries within each region, preserving each region's flood-office count and the observed road offices.
method.limitations: Exploratory tests of office co-occurrence, not intent. They do not account for project need, office workload, project mix, or selection of ₱5M and these categories after seeing the pattern. A small p-value rejects the specified chance model; it does not prove deliberate allocation.
